leadText:
Hunter D's crew members (Japanese: ハンターの部下 Hunter's underlings) are a group of characters of the day who appeared in The One That Didn't Get Away!. They assist their boss in capturing other people's Pokémon as well as ones for a living.

They helped their boss . Upon realizing this, and worked together to stop them from poaching Kyogre. With the help of their Pokémon and Kyogre, they sent them flying. They eventually landed on a beach where Officer Jenny was relaxing.
